about.title: About us
about.lead: Our center was created to provide a safe, warm and professional framework for psychotherapeutic support.
about.text: We believe that every person deserves access to quality mental health care. Our team consists of experienced mental health professionals who work with respect, confidentiality and scientific rigor. We offer individual psychotherapy, couple therapy and online sessions, tailored to the unique needs of each person.

angeliki.name: Angeliki Apostolopoulou
angeliki.credentials: BSc Psychology, MSc Early Intervention in Psychosis, Specialization in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
angeliki.bio: Angeliki Apostolopoulou is a licensed Psychologist and Cognitive Behavioral Psychotherapist, deeply devoted to mental health and well-being. A graduate of the Psychology Department at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, she completed her master's degree in 'Early Intervention in Psychosis' at the NKUA Medical School and specializes in Cognitive Behavioral Therapy through the Society for Cognitive Behavioral Studies.
angeliki.bio2: With rich clinical experience in providing psychotherapy sessions for adolescents and adults, Angeliki has worked in recognized mental health centers and psychosocial rehabilitation facilities. Her approach is characterized by empathy, scientific precision and genuine interest in every individual.
angeliki.bio3: Beyond clinical practice, Angeliki is an active speaker at national conferences on psychiatry and autism, while she holds additional training in Dance Movement Psychotherapy and Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) — reflecting a holistic and multidimensional approach to psychotherapy.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about the therapeutic process.

q1.question: Do I need a diagnosis to start psychotherapy?
q1.answer: No, you don't need any diagnosis. Psychotherapy is for anyone who wants to better understand themselves, manage difficulties or grow personally. All it takes is your own desire.

q2.question: How long does a session last and how often are they held?
q2.answer: Each session lasts 50 minutes. The frequency is determined in collaboration with your therapist, usually once a week, depending on your needs.

q3.question: Can I have online sessions?
q3.answer: Yes, we offer online sessions via secure video call. Online sessions are equally effective and ideal for those who are far away or prefer flexibility.

q4.question: How can I book a first appointment?
q4.answer: You can contact us by phone, email or through the contact form on our website. We will guide you through every step.

q5.question: Are sessions confidential?
q5.answer: Absolutely. Confidentiality is a fundamental principle of our work. Everything discussed in the context of therapy remains strictly confidential, in accordance with the code of ethics.

q6.question: What is the cost of sessions?
q6.answer: The cost depends on the type of service. Contact us for detailed information. We believe in the accessibility of mental health and offer flexible options.
